responsibility: Defines the master list of GCC timing variables using DEFTIMEVAR entries, including global phases, IPA/middle-end/backend passes, dump and GC activities, JIT-specific timers, and analyzer timers. This file is the declarative source from which the timevar_id_t enumeration and timer name table are generated, establishing the stable set of named buckets used by GCC performance measurement and -ftime-report output.
same_name_distinction: Provides the declarative master list of timing variable IDs and display names that timevar.h includes to generate the enum and that timevar.cc iterates over at runtime; unlike the .h and .cc files, it contains no timing API or implementation logic.
